## Open

### T-319 — The runbook should not wait for an answer when it has no terminal

> _2026-10-11 · test/blong-int-kustomize · open_

cycle run with no --cluster asks whether to create one and waits for a y/N. Piped into a log or run
under CI with no TTY that looks like a hang: no output, no children, an idle event loop, and nothing
says a question was asked. The machine half should either refuse with a sentence naming --cluster,
or read the default from the environment the way it reads other settings, so a headless run either
works or fails visibly.
